status: engineering prototype; digital validation required before export; physical qualification pending

display.thickness_basis: 1.18 mm reserved from product listing; V1.1 drawing says 0.92 +/-0.10 mm including edge adhesive
display.flex_tolerance_status: Prototype former R1.55. Worst length remainder 0.276 mm using 9.7 tail, 3.95 stiffener, 0.13 flex and 0.4 bonding straight. Verify contact datum and fold on first article.

battery.candidate: Renata ICP303450PA-02 (100701), protected; external Semitec 103JT-025 NTC
battery.connector: JST SM03B-SRSS-TB(LF)(SN); SHR-03V-S housing; SSH-003T-P0.2 contacts; AWG28 pigtail spliced to protected pack AWG26 leads
battery.harness: Two 40 mm AWG28 power leads, plus NTC lead, separately insulated splices; stock pack protection retained.

buttons.retention: Purchased caps press directly onto the projected plungers. Fit only after soldering; no printed cap, keeper or elastomer.

rf_keepout.scope: no copper, battery, display, screws or carrier metal; validate phone-loaded RF

carrier.retention: Experimental removable screw cradle; radio end down. The 130.8 mm portrait carrier exceeds the prior iPhone 16 Plus camera-to-bottom space; no fit claim. Qualify another phone or mounting position.
carrier.array: CIC-MAG-01, made to drawing; N48H radial accessory array, supplier qualification pending

manufacturing.panel_method: tab routing; factory to review supports and panel
manufacturing.impedance: 90 ohm USB; PCBWay published 1.2 mm four-layer entry 17, 0.1855 mm outer dielectric, er 4.74; confirm impedance with factory at order
